snippet.title: Penn Guiny's Lightmare - SAGE 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
https://bodie-the.itch.io/penn-guinys-lightmare

Penn Guiny's Lightmare is a 3D collect-a-thon platformer with a horror twist! Releasing on September 9th on #itchio and September 11th for #Sage2026

Play as Penn Guiny, who has to collect stars while being chased down by the Sun!

If you love:
The humor and gameplay of Baldi's Basics
The escape sequences of Pizza Tower
The tight platforming of Super Mario 64
Other collect-a-thon platformers
Penn Guiny
then you SHOULD play Penn Guiny's Lightmare

Feel free to stream it too!

https://bodie-the.itch.io/
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/members/bodie_the.49045/
